description.value: First Nations-operated waterfront campground on the Strait of Georgia where the Big Qualicum River meets the sea, with basic tent sites, serviced RV pads, flush washrooms, hot showers, and a playground; open May long weekend through September, with tent sites at $40/night.

address.value: 5861 West Island Hwy. (Hwy. 19), Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 1Z5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active waterfront campground operated by Qualicum First Nation, with both basic tent sites (first-come, first-served) and serviced RV sites. OSM tags tents=yes and internet_access=wlan are corroborated by the website, which lists Wi-Fi, water, and electricity on serviced sites, plus hot showers and an on-site convenience store. No phone or address were present in the OSM record; both were sourced from the website's contact page, and the OSM website URL is confirmed by the fetched content.
concerns: Two postal codes appear on the website for the same physical address: V9K 1Z5 (contact page header) and V9K 2G1 (site footer and search page) — address should be verified on-site.
OSM record lists no phone number or address; both were sourced entirely from the website.
Electricity is available on serviced RV sites ('Wi-fi - Water - Electricity') but no evidence of charging access for basic tent campers; Device charging left as null.
No hiker/biker-specific rate or cycle-tourism mention found; campground is primarily RV-oriented with basic tent overflow sites.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active waterfront campground with tent sites, hot showers, and on-site food; a practical and scenically notable overnight stop for cyclists on the Vancouver Island east-coast touring route.
